subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: 3D objects and 2D shapes
source.subtopic: 3D objects: position and directions; follow directions (right, left)

show.line: Follow the directions! Put the ball on the box. Turn left. Turn right. Let's move things!

rounds.prompt: Put the ball under the table. Which picture is right?
The robot turns left. Which way does it face now?
Put the box behind the chair. Tap the right picture.
Is the cup on the left or the right of the plate? Say it.
Walk forward two steps, then turn right. Where is the dog now?
Which block is in front of the cylinder?

hints: Hold up your left hand. Left is that side.
Behind is at the back. In front is at the front.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Put the ball to the right of the box.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Here! I put it on the left.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I put it on the left. Right is the other side.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's hold up our right hands. The ball goes on this side!

parent_line: Can follow directions using left, right, in front of, behind, on and under.
